transcription_check.checked_by: Codex translation worker; same-agent review, no independent specialist review
transcription_check.evidence: Individually inspected all20 Poppler page images /tmp/semetey1-volta-0916-0935/page-0916.png through page-0935.png. Read left column then right; pages922 and934 two-fragment chapter headings explicitly classified. Every indented continuation grouped with exact raw text, source IDs and bboxes; no fixed row assumption. Primary Kyrgyz/Russian Yudakhin dictionary and Kyrgyz1960Semetey glossary images used only as lexical aids. No previous English poem translation used.
transcription_check.pair_review: All 1520 reconstructed source-English pairs read in order: nine blocks of160, then80 (640–799 reread after a context-truncated attempt). All53 revised pairs and48 final whole-held source verses separately reread. 48 whole unresolved verses excluded with exact source fragments and specific reasons. Narrative covers Semetey defeating his uncles and companions, Bakai ordering burial, Semetey ruling Talas and sending four envoys, Chynkozho refusing their request, Kulchoro striking him and raiding his horses, Chynkozho forcing his people to migrate, and his oath-bound alliance with Toltoy. Every repetition, source casualty claim, number, miracle, insult and contradiction retained. No expert certification.
